title: UAP science advisory committee's first Zoom meeting
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of UAP science advisory committee's first Zoom meeting, about 2026 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: what we're worried about okay so this is a point of discussion in our first Zoom meeting was what if they misdirect us and go hey aby here's some stuff now go spend a few weeks analyzing that.

plain: A researcher named Michael Shurmer says that in 2026 he sat on a White House science advisory committee about unexplained flying objects. He says that at its first Zoom meeting the members worried the government might mislead them, for example by handing a researcher named Avi Loeb some material just to keep him busy analyzing it for weeks. If true, even the official advisers doubted they would be shown the real evidence.
